text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out with Katsuragi Ace, I received information
that there was a thrill-ride spot nearby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She mentioned before that she wanted to experience fear.
This might be a good opportunity.
choice_data_list: Want to go find out what real fear is?
Want to go find out what real fear is?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm going!! Trainer,
you actually remembered! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: So this time it's a scream-inducing hotspot, huh!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It shakes a bit, but... isn't this more fun
than scary?
choice_data_list: W-Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She remained completely unfazed by the swaying.
However, one misstep would send her plunging
straight down off the bridge... It was impossible not to feel terrified.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, are you okay?
What happened? You froze up all of a sudden.
choice_data_list: Ah, my legs froze up...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it really is tough footing.
It'd be dangerous if you took a misstep...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll balance things from the front so we don't wobble!
Just follow me slowly!
choice_data_list: Oh, thank you...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: If it gets too scary, you can hold onto me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words made my frozen feet start moving again.
It was truly a wonder...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Next, we headed to a popular seaside cliff known for being a thrill spot.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, awesome! The sea spray's
flying all the way over here!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Take a look down the cliff too, Trainer!
The waves crashing against the rocks are so pretty!
choice_data_list: Come on, it's scary...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Are you scared?!
...Wait, what on earth are you actually scared of?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful ocean and crystal-clear blue skies...
There's nothing scary here at all, is there?
choice_data_list: Falling off a cliff would be fatal...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha! What's the point of worrying about the worst-case scenario?
You're letting it go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you've got me.
If you're ever about to fall, I'll grab hold and support you!
choice_data_list: I see... In that case, let's just enjoy the scenery!
I see... In that case, let's just enjoy the scenery!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's the spirit!
Come on, since we're here, let's push it right to the limit!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's sooo not it!
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...A bit late to realize this, but...
Even though we went to a thrilling spot,
the two of us just ended up having fun..."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, wasn't the Trainer
acting totally fine by the end of it too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Indeed, being with her seemed to make the fear fade quite a bit. I told her that thanks to her, I wasn't scared.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? Not just me,
but even you've gotten totally fearless, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, I feel like I'm getting
further and further away from fear...
choice_data_list: Still, your fearlessness is also your strength.
Still, your fearlessness is also your strength.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: My... strengths...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A dignified posture born from a complete lack of fear.
Brave words spoken precisely because she is undaunted.
Many people find salvation in the way she carries herself.
choice_data_list: I'm one of them too.
I'm one of them too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Me, to the rescue...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Then, is it alright for me...
to remain fearless?"
choice_data_list: You can become strong because you know no fear!
You can become strong because you know no fear!
Yeah. Just don't do anything reckless, please.
Yeah. Just don't be reckless, okay?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Then, is it alright for me...
to remain fearless?"
choice_data_list: You can become strong because you know no fear!
You can become strong because you know no fear!
Yeah. Just don't do anything reckless, please.
Yeah. Just don't be reckless, okay?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I see...!
In that case, we've gotta pursue this to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: A fearless strength that is entirely my own!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This new realization
will surely make her even stronger.
I look forward to seeing her grow.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I know. Even if I'm fearless, I can still tell what's dangerous and what isn't.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry so much.
Let's relax our shoulders a bit more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I can't help feeling that's a bit too optimistic.
A sliver of unease crossed my mind."
